clue.text: Weapon provided by man, a proponent of war

parts.note: Tom is a stock man's name (and a male cat)
a hawk is a politician who favours military action

explanation.surface: A weapon supplied by a warmongering man.
explanation.definitionFit: A tomahawk is a light axe used as a weapon by Native Americans.

clue.text: Asian giant has to live in hiding

indicators.note: something in hiding is tucked away inside, so one piece lies concealed within the other

parts.note: a Titan is one of the giants of Greek myth
to be is to exist, to live

explanation.surface: A huge Asian man forced to go into hiding.
explanation.definitionFit: A Tibetan is a native of Tibet, a region of Asia, so an Asian person.

clue.text: Made a connection shown in timetable

indicators.note: the letters are on display within the word timetable

explanation.surface: A train connection appearing in the timetable.
explanation.definitionFit: To have met a train or person is to have made a connection with it.

clue.text: Coheir upset over improper form of government

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means placed above the next piece
upset means knocked over, so the letters of coheir are thrown into a new order

parts.note: racy means risqué, slightly improper

explanation.surface: A joint heir is annoyed by an unsuitable kind of regime.
explanation.definitionFit: Hierocracy is rule by priests, a form of government.

clue.text: Shrink appearing to gain support of church

indicators.note: in a down clue the second piece sits under the first, as its support

parts.note: to win is to gain
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A psychiatrist seemingly winning backing from the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shrink' looks like slang for a psychiatrist, but it is the verb: to recoil.
explanation.definitionFit: To wince is to shrink back or flinch in pain or distaste.

clue.text: Joke — dig at the state

parts.note: a pun is a joke on words
a jab is a poke or dig

explanation.surface: A gibe and a jibe aimed at the government.
explanation.definitionFit: Punjab is a state of India (and a province of Pakistan).

clue.text: Tree dad planted in America

indicators.note: planted in suggests setting one piece into the other like a seedling

parts.note: US is the United States, America
pa is an informal word for dad

explanation.surface: Father puts in a tree while living in the States.
explanation.definitionFit: The upas is a tropical Asian tree with poisonous sap.

clue.text: On bats, umpire is inclined to be critical

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means the first piece sits on top of the next

parts.note: an umpire acts as judge
bats is slang for crazy, mental

explanation.surface: A cricket umpire tending to find fault with the batsmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone judgemental is quick to criticise others.

clue.text: Container of water? That's about right

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the container goes round the letter for right

parts.note: a beaker is a drinking vessel, a container

explanation.surface: A jug of water seems about right.
explanation.walkthrough: The reader takes 'Container of water' as one phrase, but 'Container' alone is the beaker and 'of' links to the definition; the question mark flags a breaker as a kind of water.
explanation.definitionFit: A breaker is a heavy wave crashing on the shore, an example of water in motion.

clue.text: Sporting top hat, of course

indicators.note: sporting suggests the letters are frolicking about into a new order

explanation.surface: Wearing a top hat, naturally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sporting' looks like wearing, and 'of course' like an idiom, but 'course' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A footpath is a path or course for walkers.

clue.text: Confidentially, our inheritance may be so divided

definitions.meaning: said in secret, as a private matter between two people

definitions.text: our inheritance may be so divided
definitions.meaning: an estate shared by two heirs would be split in two

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means privately, and literally describes a share split by two people.

clue.text: Artist interested in interrupting music in quicker time -but not the intro

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into another piece
the introduction, the opening letter, is dropped from the word

parts.note: a stretto is a passage played at a faster tempo
to be into something is to be interested in it

explanation.surface: A painter keen on breaking into a faster passage, minus its opening.
explanation.definitionFit: Tintoretto was a Venetian Renaissance painter.

clue.text: Florence, a square singer

definitions.meaning: the first name of the Crimean War nurse known as the Lady with the Lamp
the bird in the song A ... Sang in Berkeley Square, a London square

explanation.definitionFit: Florence Nightingale was the famous nurse; the bird is the singer of the Berkeley Square song.

clue.text: Yank, a contemptibly foolish person

explanation.definitionFit: A jerk is both a sudden pull and slang for an obnoxious fool.

clue.text: Bar is located outside Scottish town in fields

parts.note: a bail is the crossbar on top of cricket stumps (also a bar in a stable)

indicators.note: located outside means the word is sits around the town

parts.note: Wick is a town in Caithness, northern Scotland

explanation.surface: A pub situated beyond a Scottish town amid farmland.
explanation.definitionFit: Bailiwicks are areas of jurisdiction or expertise, someone's fields.

clue.text: Broadcast, say, in backward country

indicators.note: backward means the whole string is read from end to start

parts.note: to air a programme is to broadcast it
eg, for example, means say
taken as written

explanation.surface: Transmissions, for instance, in a less developed nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Nigeria is a country in West Africa.

clue.text: I forget a cinema's refurbished

indicators.note: refurbished means done up anew, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive s is kept as a letter of the fodder

explanation.surface: Someone forgets that a picture house has been renovated.
explanation.definitionFit: An amnesiac is a person who forgets, who might well say I forget.

clue.text: Game's over, after a final move revealing inept player

indicators.note: after means the reversed game comes behind the other pieces

parts.note: mate, checkmate, is the final move in chess

indicators.note: over means turned the other way round

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a game

explanation.surface: Checkmate ends the game, exposing a weak chess player.
explanation.definitionFit: An amateur, a non-professional, can mean someone unskilled.

clue.text: Pope's office unoccupied? Not totally — Italian's about to occupy it

indicators.note: to occupy is to take up space within, so one piece sits inside the other
not totally means the word lacks its final letter

parts.note: vacant means unoccupied

indicators.note: about here means turned around to face the other way, so the short form for Italian is read backwards

parts.note: It is short for Italian, as in gin and It

explanation.surface: The papal seat lies empty until an Italian comes to fill it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Vatican is the seat and administration of the papacy.

clue.text: It's obvious base is occupied by a relative

indicators.note: the base word has the relative living inside it

parts.note: base means low and vile
a sib is a sibling, a relative

explanation.surface: Clearly a relative is living at the military base.
explanation.definitionFit: Something obvious is visible, plain to see.

clue.text: Summit husband and I will conquer

parts.note: I'll is the contraction of I will
to top is to beat or conquer

explanation.surface: A married pair vow to reach the peak together.
explanation.definitionFit: A hilltop is the summit of a hill.

clue.text: Entertainer offered support to king that's been overthrown

parts.note: a pier is a pillar, a support

indicators.note: overthrown means turned upside down, read upwards in a down clue

parts.note: taken as written
R is short for rex, king

explanation.surface: A performer backed a deposed monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Pierrot is the sad white-faced clown of French pantomime, an entertainer.

clue.text: Celebrated animals' return

indicators.note: return means come back, so the word reads backwards

parts.note: gnus are wildebeest, animals

explanation.surface: Animals that have come home are fêted.
explanation.definitionFit: Sung, as in praises sung, means celebrated or lauded.

clue.text: Cold war is recreated by English playwright

indicators.note: recreated means made again in a different form, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: The Cold War restaged by an English dramatist.
explanation.definitionFit: Oscar Wilde was an Irish playwright, author of The Importance of Being Earnest.

clue.text: Grab girl, wanting a kiss

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name
X represents a kiss at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: Seize a girl, wanting a kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: To annex territory is to grab or seize it.

clue.text: Wife lost scrappy game

indicators.note: lost means the letter for wife has gone from the word

parts.note: wispy means thin and scrappy, in fragments

explanation.surface: A wife lost a messy game.
explanation.definitionFit: I spy is a children's guessing game.

clue.text: Three forms of transport that may be used by people working at a height

definitions.text: may be used by people working at a height

parts.note: boats carry people over water
wains are farm wagons
a chair is a sedan chair, carried by bearers

explanation.surface: Three vehicles suitable for steeplejacks.
explanation.definitionFit: A boatswain's chair is a plank seat slung on ropes for working aloft on masts or buildings.

clue.text: Service that's never returned long, but not hard

indicators.note: but not means the letter for hard is left out

parts.note: to ache for something is to long for it
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A tennis serve nobody can get back, long rather than hard.
explanation.definitionFit: An ace is a tennis serve the receiver cannot touch, so it never comes back.

clue.text: Girl who wrote a diary

definitions.meaning: John ..., the seventeenth-century English diarist, contemporary of Pepys

explanation.definitionFit: It is a girl's name and the surname of the diarist John Evelyn.

clue.text: Being roughly sixteen tons

indicators.note: roughly means not precisely, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Weighing about sixteen tons.
explanation.definitionFit: Being, as an adjective, means existing at present, in existence.
